title: C2 Curation context endpoint and priming target config
description: GET /api/newsroom/curation/context returning CurationBootstrap; optional per-binding priming.listId in the trusted target config (strict parsing); a binding without a list returns priming:null; zero transformers listed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: GET /api/newsroom/curation/context returns CurationBootstrap (mode remote, priming {listId, classifiers, transformers: []} or null, capabilities read[+review], bindingRef null). Per-binding priming.listId parsed strictly in targets_from_environment (PublicationBinding.priming_list_id). Specs: context_lists_the_configured_priming_contract_and_no_transformers, priming_list_configuration_is_parsed_strictly_and_optionally.
